dct_creator_sm: Steel, Elisabeth (Queen's University, Department of Geological Sciences and Geological Engineering). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7832-0528
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the data from XES10 Experiment originally published in Hajek et al., 2014, 'Amplification of Shoreline Response to Sea Level Change by Back-Tilted Subsidence' (https://doi.org/10.2110/jsr.2014.34) and codes developed in Steel et al. (Submitted), 'Reconstructing subsurface sandbody connectivity from temporal evolution of surface networks'. Experiments were conducted at Saint Anthony Falls Laboratory at the University of Minnesota.
dct_title_s: Synthetic Stratigraphy of River Deltas from Overhead Imagery
